difficulty_reason: The lemma compares two topologies at the level of derived categories: under the covering and vanishing conditions for a family of objects, the given subcategory is a weak Serre subcategory of the modules on the finer site and the pullback and derived pushforward give an equivalence of triangulated categories (statement lines 6550-6570). The proof is a complete argument: the identification of the subcategory with its image and the quasi-inverse equivalences are established (proof lines 6574-6592); the vanishing of the positive higher direct images is deduced from the two assumptions through the description of those sheaves (proof lines 6594-6600); the image is shown to be a weak Serre subcategory by a comparison diagram and the five lemma (proof lines 6600-6652); and the five conditions of the comparison criterion are checked, yielding the equivalence (proof lines 6654-6666). The non-formal content is the verification of the weak Serre property and of the criterion. The claim is H2: a structured argument with each input named.
